source.publication: 2025 Oklahoma Resident Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions (Form 511 packet)
source.section: Form 511 lines 1-14 and 18 (PDF pages 42-43); select line instructions (PDF pages 9-10); standard deduction line 10 (PDF page 10); exemptions line 11 and the Regular exemption terms (PDF pages 8 and 10); Tax Table (PDF pages 27-38); Special exemption and Sixty-five or older (PDF page 9)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 25,000.00 = 25,000.00. Federal taxable income = 25,000.00 - standard deduction 33,100.00 (31,500.00 + 1 x 1,600.00 for 65 or older) = -8,100.00, floored at 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Oklahoma starts from federal AGI). Form 511: line 1 federal AGI 25,000.00; line 2 subtractions 0.00; line 3 = 25,000.00 - 0.00 = 25,000.00; line 4 out-of-state income 0.00; line 5 25,000.00; line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 Oklahoma AGI 25,000.00; line 8 adjustments 0.00; line 9 25,000.00; line 10 standard deduction (married joint) 12,700.00; line 11 exemptions: 2 Regular + 1 Special = 3 x 1,000.00 = 3,000.00 (1 person(s) 65 or older; line 1 25,000.00 is within the 25,000.00 limit, so 1 Special); line 12 = 12,700.00 + 3,000.00 = 15,700.00; line 13 taxable income = 25,000.00 - 15,700.00 = 9,300.00; line 14 tax (the projection's brackets as numbers; the booklet prints only a table and worksheets): 0.25% x 2,000.00 = 5.0000 + 0.75% x 3,000.00 = 22.5000 + 1.75% x 2,500.00 = 43.7500 + 2.75% x 1,800.00 = 49.5000; total 120.7500 = 120.75. Line 13 is under 100,000, so the form reads the tax table: row 9,300-9,350, column 'Married filing joint or head of household', PDF page 28, gives 121; expected keeps the schedule figure. Lines 15-17 credits 0.00; line 18 income tax 120.75. The exemption is for each taxpayer or spouse 65 or older: only the spouse counts, though the wages are yours.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are derived from the printed tax table and the 100,000-and-over worksheets; the booklet prints no schedule. Below 100,000 tax is figured on the exact income, where the booklet taxes each 50-dollar row at its midpoint and rounds. At 100,000 and over the single and separate worksheet starts from 4,562 where the schedule gives 4,561.50.
